settings.fixed: candidate edit, directional hold, retained paper-applied geometry, original observed L seam

reference_modes.raw_L_colour: old known AND raw L>=50, Ldrop[-6,4]
reference_modes.raw_Lab_colour: raw_L_colour AND abs(raw a-paper a)<=2, abs(raw b-paper b)<=4

settings.qualification_paper: same preprocessor estimate from full-page median Lab; classification only, frozen before colour solve
settings.restorer: same raw/sigma6 known-only smooth harmonic fields, boundary mix8, minimum16 adjacent pairs
settings.colour_change: baseline float field plus newly computed colour minus saved baseline colour, original fine L retained
settings.unsupported: retain saved baseline when new qualification gives insufficient16-pair support; no new applied pixels
settings.texture_reference: old qualified paper unchanged, separate from colour-only qualification
settings.control: recompute old-known colour using same fixed active mask, to isolate historical-field recomputation
